title: `claim_revenue` lets admin block user withdrawals below min threshold
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  The `claim_revenue` function should not be executable if the revenue falls below the `min_threshold`. In this case, users are allowed to reclaim their payment tokens after the sale duration ends. However, if the admin calls the `claim_revenue` function immediately after the sale ends, users will no longer be able to withdraw their payment tokens via `withdraw_token`.
